title: Two Out Of Three
description:
Given three integer arrays nums1, nums2, and nums3, return a distinct array containing all the values that are present in at least two out of the three arrays. Return the qualifying values in ascending numeric order.

## Examples

### Example 1

```text
Input: nums1 = [1,1,3,2], nums2 = [2,3], nums3 = [3]
Output: [2,3]
```

The value 3 appears in all three arrays, and 2 appears in nums1 and nums2.

### Example 2

```text
Input: nums1 = [3,1], nums2 = [2,3], nums3 = [1,2]
Output: [1,2,3]
```

The values 1, 2, and 3 each appear in two arrays.

### Example 3

```text
Input: nums1 = [1,2,2], nums2 = [4,3,3], nums3 = [5]
Output: []
```

No value is present in at least two arrays.

## Constraints

- 1 <= nums1.length, nums2.length, nums3.length <= 100
- 1 <= nums1[i], nums2[j], nums3[k] <= 100
